name: DokiDoki Pretty League Final
source:
Pink Angels who won the JPL league discover their trophy disappearance one day. Hero does not want publicity and wants to hire a private detective. But on his way there he attends a birthday party of one of team members and discovers the cup in one of the rooms...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-july-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
赢得JPL联赛冠军的粉红天使队，某天发现奖杯不见了。主人公不想把事情闹大，于是决定雇用私家侦探。然而在前往侦探事务所的路上，他参加了队员的生日聚会，并在其中一间房里发现了奖杯……

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-july-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
